$comment: #EXP-2109 (owner 2026-11-25) THE HEADER ACTIONS: ONE rule for the trailing side of every page's header ×5 (iOS, Android, web-mobile, web md+, the desktop IDE). LEFT: the back control (pushed pages), the leading glyph, the title, never centred. RIGHT: `order`, headerActions(page): status (what the page reports: the waiting chips, the issue graph), primary (the page's ONE labelled verb: Create, Publish, Start, the Merge pill; the only text a header holds), call, page (the page's own icon: the inbox's mark read, a device's settings), search, inbox, add, more; a page lists only what it has (`pages`, phone and wide; null = the page has no header there). Every action but status and primary is THE ROUND ICON BUTTON, one look everywhere: `circle` px on phones (the filled circle of the page header: web FabButton, Android BarCircle, iOS the native toolbar circle), `wideCircle` px on web md+ and the IDE (the same filled circle); the glyph `glyph` / `wideGlyph`. ADD = concept `icons.add`, always its OWN button, never an entry of the `…`; it runs the page's one create verb at once (`adds`), or opens the create menu where there are several. MORE = concept `icons.more`, always LAST, only secondary verbs: headerMenu(entries) = the page's menu without `menuDrops` (what the + does), separators tidied; an empty one = no button. ROWS that carry the pair (a team's row in the tree, `rows`) wear the same + then …. A row's long-press / right-click keeps its WHOLE menu (sidebar-menus.json). A settings list's own New pill in its section band is not a header.
